entities.summary: Guy Maurice McIntyre is an American former professional football player who was a guard in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Georgia Bulldogs and was selected by the San Francisco 49ers in the third round of the 1984 NFL draft. McIntyre played in three Super Bowls and five Pro Bowls with the 49ers.
